# The Rust password-storage disable is a historical Thunderbird preference override

This landing adds signon.storage.rust.enabled=false with a compatibility-bug comment. The fixed accepted Thunderbird preference file no longer contains that literal key. Keep the temporary historical override separate from current backend behavior: this scoped source comparison does not inspect inherited defaults, the Gecko consumer or profile migration. No password-storage operation or test was run.

Scope: Thunderbird default preferences.
